We value collaboration, creativity, and ownership, and we are intentional about building not only powerful products, but also a culture where people feel supported, heard, and inspired to do their best work.

With strong momentum and the recent acquisition of Microvellum, a trusted leader in design to manufacturing solutions for the woodworking industry, INNERGY is entering an exciting new phase of growth. This combination expands our capabilities, deepens our industry impact, and accelerates our vision of delivering a truly connected, end to end platform for custom manufacturers.

As we scale thoughtfully and bring together top talent and new perspectives, this is a unique opportunity to join a company where your work will have visible impact, your ideas will help shape decisions, and your contributions will play a meaningful role in defining the future of a fast evolving product, team, and industry.

Job Description

We're looking for a versatile, hands-on Marketing Specialist who thrives as a generalist and can move fluidly between product marketing content, web production, and performance channels. You'll be the kind of marketer who can write a compelling product page in the morning, build and publish it in WordPress over lunch, and optimize a paid search and social campaign by the afternoon. You're equally comfortable thinking about messaging and positioning as you are reading a CPL report.

This is a high-impact role for someone who wants ownership across the funnel and the chance to directly influence pipeline at a fast-growing vertical SaaS company. If you like wearing multiple hats, learning a niche industry deeply, and seeing your work drive measurable results, you'll fit right in.

title: Clinical Coordination Manager
description:
Department: Support Operations

Reports To: Director, Support Operations

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Position Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Position Summary

The Clinical Coordinator Department Manager oversees the Clinical Coordination team responsible for maintaining accurate, appropriately filled provider schedules across all markets. This role provides leadership, operational oversight, training, workload management, process improvement, and cross-department collaboration to support consistent scheduling performance.

This leader sets daily and weekly priorities, delegates work, holds the team accountable, monitors current and upcoming schedule health, and identifies risks before they impact provider days. The manager ensures accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked and that scheduling barriers are tracked and escalated to the appropriate owner.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Performance Management

- Lead, mentor, and develop Clinical Coordinators through clear priorities, delegation, accountability, and follow-through
- Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, coaching, and ongoing training refreshers
- Oversee team scheduling, workload balancing, and coverage across markets based on provider days, appointment volume, and overall workload
- Support onboarding and competency development for new team members
- Foster a positive, efficient, and collaborative culture grounded in service excellence and ownership

Appointment Readiness & Schedule Reliability

- Monitor the 0-14-day schedule and upcoming weeks to identify open capacity, underfilled provider days, and scheduling risks early
- Ensure accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked in accordance with provider availability, market zoning, and scheduling priorities
- Ensure Clinical Coordinators identify, track, and escalate scheduling barriers, including outstanding medical clearances, insurance verification, pre-medication needs, facility documentation, and lab-case concerns, to the appropriate department or owner
- Monitor Clinical Days at Goal and schedule disruptions to ensure timely follow-up and improve filled provider days across applicable markets
- Ensure schedules are entered timely and accurately while production-based scheduling remains focused appropriately

Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement

- Analyze recurring scheduling barriers, backlog trends, fall-aparts, and schedule-health concerns to identify operational gaps and root causes
- Develop preventive strategies and implement workflow or SOP improvements within Clinical Coordination
- Coordinate any workflow change affecting another department or external partner with the appropriate department leader or Account Manager before implementation
- Support system optimization, automation initiatives, and process refinements in CareStack and Healier

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner across departments to resolve scheduling barriers, maintain clear ownership, and support consistent patient flow
- Serve as an escalation point for complex scheduling needs or facility and provider concerns
- Independently address department concerns, communicate risks and updates, and escalate to the Director when additional leadership support is needed

Data, Reporting & Accountability

- Monitor and report team performance and operational health indicators, including:
- Clinical Days at Goal
- 0-14-day schedule health and upcoming provider weeks
- Accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlog progress
- Schedule-entry timeliness
- Reschedule, cancellation, and fall-apart trends
- Outstanding scheduling barriers and escalations
- Provide weekly insights, actions taken, next steps, and performance updates to leadership
- Ensure accurate documentation standards in CareStack and Healier

Requirements

Qualifications

- Experience: 5+ years in dental, medical, or clinical scheduling/coordination; minimum 2 years leadership experience
- Systems: Experience with CareStack, or similar EMR platforms and Google Suite required
- Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical/dental workflows, provider scheduling, multi-facility coordination, pre-med & medical clearance processes, insurance verification, lab case coordination, and multi-facility scheduling
- Leadership: Demonstrated success managing remote teams, assigning and delegating work, coaching performance, holding employees accountable, and implementing process improvements. 
- Skills:
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
- Strong organizational, delegation, and prioritization abilities
- Ability to independently assess problems, make decisions, and follow through
- Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment

Key Competencies

- Leadership & team development
- Delegation, accountability & follow-through
- Proactive problem solving & root-cause thinking
- Schedule-health oversight & workload management
- Workflow optimization & accuracy
- Efficient decision-making & prioritization
- Cross-functional collaboration
- Service-minded communication with professionalism and empathy

Work Environment

- Fully remote role requiring reliable internet access
- Requires ongoing communication with team members, facilities, providers, and internal departments via virtual platforms
- Occasional travel for leadership meetings, in-field shadow sessions, or training as needed

Benefits

Compensation: Base compensation $60,000-65,000 annually

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Life Insurance, Paid Time Off

description:
About the role
The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do - Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
- Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
- Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
- Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
- Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
- Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
- Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
- Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.

What we are looking for - A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
- Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
- Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
- Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
- Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
- A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.

How we work
We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers - A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
- Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
- Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
- The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
- Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

Deine Rolle 

Du kennst den Bankalltag und weißt, worauf es bei Qualität und Genauigkeit wirklich ankommt? Dann ist das deine Chance, deine bankfachliche Erfahrung in die Welt der Softwarequalität einzubringen.

Als Softwaretester (m/w/d) im Bankenumfeld verbindest du dein Verständnis für Abläufe, Produkte und Prozesse im Bankgeschäft mit einem Blick für technische Details. Du prüfst, ob neue oder weiterentwickelte Systeme fachlich korrekt funktionieren, also so wie Bankkaufleute sie wirklich brauchen.

Wenn du also aus der Bank kommst und mehr Einblick in die IT gewinnen möchtest oder bereits als Softwaretester im Bankumfeld tätig bist und deine bankfachliche Expertise weiter ausbauen willst, bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Über uns 

Die CPU Consulting & Software GmbH  ist seit über vier Jahrzehnten als IT-Partner der Finanzbranche erfolgreich. Als Teil der CPU-Gruppe verbinden wir tiefes  Banking-Know-how  mit Technologiekompetenz und begleiten Banken sowie IT-Dienstleister bei der digitalen Transformation – von der Idee bis zum Go-live.

Du stellst sicher, dass Softwarelösungen nicht nur technisch einwandfrei , sondern auch fachlich präzise und bankkonform umgesetzt werden. Damit leistest du einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Qualität und Zukunftssicherheit moderner Banking-Systeme.

Aufgaben

- Du analysierst Anforderungen und entwickelst darauf basierend Testfälle und Testkonzepte.

- Du führst manuelle und automatisierte Tests durch und dokumentierst Ergebnisse präzise.

- Du unterstützt bei Abnahmetests direkt beim Kunden und begleitest Fachbereiche bei der Einführung neuer Systeme.

- Du trägst zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Teststrategie bei und bringst neue Ideen zur Qualitätssicherung ein.

- Du arbeitest eng mit Business Analysten, Entwicklern und Fachabteilungen zusammen – auf Augenhöhe und lösungsorientiert.

Qualifikation

- Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Bankkaufmann/-frau oder bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bankwesen mit.

- Du bist neugierig auf IT und möchtest deine bankfachliche Expertise in Softwareprojekte einbringen .

- Alternativ hast du bereits Erfahrung als Softwaretester im Bankumfeld.

- Eine ISTQB-Zertifizierung ist von Vorteil, ebenso wie Erfahrung mit Testtools wie Jira, Confluence, Aqua, Postman, Selenium, Cypress oder FitNesse.

- Du arbeitest strukturiert, qualitätsbewusst und verlierst auch in komplexen Szenarien nicht den Überblick.

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab.

Benefits

- Zukunftssicherheit: 

Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag und eine Bezuschussung der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit 20% geben dir Stabilität und Sicherheit für deine Zukunft.

- Innovatives und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld: 

Wir bieten dir eine langfristige Perspektive in einer Branche, die sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt mit Raum für persönliches Wachstum. Durch gezielte Schulungen erhältst du die Möglichkeit, deine Fähigkeiten zu vertiefen und dich in der IT-Welt weiterzubilden.

- Attraktive Vergütung: 

Wir schätzen deine Leistungen! Im Hinblick auf deine Qualifikationen bieten wir dir eine Vergütung zwischen 55.000 und 85.000 Euro brutto im Jahr, abhängig von Berufserfahrung und Senioritäten-Level.

- Flexibilität: 

Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Gleitzeitkonto und die Möglichkeit mobil zu arbeiten, um dein Berufs- und Privatleben optimal miteinander zu vereinbaren.

- Benefits :

Nutze unser attraktives Hardware- und Bike Leasing sowie den Zugang zu einem Mitarbeiterrabattportal mit 600 namenhaften Unternehmen und spare dabei Geld.

Du findest dich in unserem Profil wieder? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen! Bitte sende uns hierzu deine vollständige, deutschsprachige Bewerbung mit frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung zu.

title: Support Engineer Firewall & Netzwerk (m/w/d)
description:
Diese Position ist für unsere Gesellschaft Medialine EuroTrade AG zu besetzen.

Du möchtest Firewalls und Netzwerke nicht nur bedienen, sondern wirklich verstehen? 

Bei uns bist Du nicht der Generalist für alles, sondern entwickelst Dich gezielt im Bereich Firewall und Netzwerk weiter. Du analysierst Störungen, konfigurierst Firewalls, Switches und Access Points und betreust Netzwerkumgebungen unterschiedlicher Kunden. Dadurch sammelst Du in kurzer Zeit deutlich mehr praktische Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Herstellern und Umgebungen als in einer klassischen Inhouse-IT.

Als Teil unseres Support-Teams bist Du Ansprechpartner für Netzwerk- und Firewall-Themen, unterstützt unseren Service Desk bei tiefergehenden Fragen und arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Support Engineers zusammen. Du musst noch kein Netzwerk-Profi sein – erste praktische Erfahrung reicht. Wir bauen Dein Wissen gemeinsam durch Einarbeitung, Wissenstransfer und Herstellerzertifizierungen aus.

Aufgaben

- Annahme, Analyse und Bearbeitung von Störungen und Anfragen im Bereich Netzwerk und Firewall per Telefon, E-Mail und Ticketsystem

- Konfiguration und Betreuung von Firewalls (z. B. Sophos Firewall, Fortinet FortiGate) – Regelwerke, NAT, VPN

- Administration von Netzwerkkomponenten wie Switches und Access Points (z. B. Ubiquiti UniFi, Fortinet oder Sophos)

- Einrichtung und Support von Site-to-Site- und Client-VPN-Verbindungen

- Analyse von Netzwerkproblemen (DNS, DHCP, VLAN, Routing) gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden

- Dokumentation von Konfigurationen, Änderungen und Lösungen

- Unterstützung unseres Service Desks als fachlicher Ansprechpartner für Netzwerk- und Firewall-Themen

- Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Support Engineers bei komplexeren Themen und Projekten

- arbeiten nach definierten Prozessen und Qualitätsstandards

Qualifikation

Das solltest Du mitbringen 

- abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung (z. B. Fachinformatiker/in Systemintegration) oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung

- Berufserfahrung im IT-Support, Service Desk oder in der Systemadministration

- Grundverständnis von Netzwerken (TCP/IP, VLAN, Routing, DNS, DHCP)

- erste praktische Erfahrung mit Firewalls (z. B. Sophos Firewall oder Fortinet FortiGate) und/oder Netzwerkkomponenten (z. B. Ubiquiti UniFi)

- gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Windows Client-Betriebssystemen

- Freude an der Analyse technischer Probleme und Interesse, Dich im Netzwerk- und Security-Umfeld zu spezialisieren

- Service- und kundenorientiertes Denken

- selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

- sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse

Von Vorteil 

- Erfahrung im Systemhaus- oder MSP-Umfeld

- Kenntnisse in Sophos Central, FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer oder UniFi Network Controller

- Herstellerzertifizierungen (z. B. Sophos Certified Engineer, Fortinet NSE 4, Cisco CCNA)

- Grundkenntnisse in Windows-Server-Umgebungen, Active Directory oder Microsoft 365

- erste Berührungspunkte mit Virtualisierung (Hyper-V oder VMware)

- ITIL-Kenntnisse oder entsprechende Zertifizierungen

- Führerschein Klasse B

Benefits

Das erwartet Dich 

- ein abwechslungsreiches Arbeitsumfeld mit unterschiedlichen Kunden, Herstellern und Netzwerkumgebungen

- gezielte fachliche Spezialisierung im Bereich Firewall, Netzwerk und IT-Security

- strukturierte Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen

- geförderte individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Zertifizierungsmöglichkeiten z.B. bei Sophos und Fortinet

- Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung System Engineering Netzwerk & Security

Weitere Benefits, je nach Standort und Tätigkeitsbereich

title: Customer Success Consultant - Retail Media
description:
About Mirakl: 

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com .

Mirakl in Numbers: 

- 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40

- 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values: 

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

- 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

- 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results

- 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence

- 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture

- 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

Customer Success Consultant - Mirakl Ads (Munich) 

About the role 

Launched three years ago, Mirakl Ads is Mirakl's global Retail Media technology, empowering eCommerce and Marketplace operators to run successful and profitable Retail Media programs. Now entering a new phase of scale, Mirakl Ads is expanding its client base, developing its media offering, and accelerating its impact across key markets worldwide.

As an Experienced Customer Success Consultant for Mirakl Ads, reporting to the Director of Customer Success, your primary mission is to support Mirakl Ads clients in launching and growing their advertising revenues - from strategy design to day-to-day performance optimization. The ideal candidate is a driven, curious and client-obsessed professional, who thrives in complex, fast-moving environments and brings the energy and structure needed to turn ambition into results.

What you will do at Mirakl 

The Experienced Customer Success Consultant will have a strong impact on Mirakl Ads growth, managing a portfolio of key clients across all stages of their journey.

- Lead clients from strategy to implementation : define their Retail Media vision and Mirakl Ads roadmap, design the right organizational setup, co-build a sharp commercial action plan with the right KPIs, and drive execution - ensuring a successful and lasting integration of Retail Media into their business, from first workshops through go-live and beyond

- Deliver strategic recommendations at business reviews, presenting to client teams and C-levels, sharing market insights and case studies to inspire performance and long-term growth

- Design and implement the right KPI frameworks to monitor clients' advertising network performance and continuously identify growth levers

- Support clients in the day-to-day optimization of their Mirakl Ads use (placements, campaign configuration, etc.), ensuring platform adoption and maximizing advertising revenues

- Lead tailored workshops and training sessions to ensure optimal onboarding and sustained platform mastery over time

As part of a growing and structured team, you will also:

- Contribute to the continuous improvement and industrialization of Customer Success processes and tooling, ensuring scalable and efficient operations as the Mirakl Ads client base grows. Collaborate with BI teams to analyze client activity and monitor advertising network performance

- Leverage AI tools and capabilities to enhance the way we deliver value to clients and scale our operations - from automating reporting and insights generation to accelerating strategic recommendations and improving the overall client experience

- Act internally as the voice of the Publisher, providing Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams with actionable insights on how Mirakl Ads fits and solves client needs at scale

- Stay ahead of market trends and competitive dynamics in the Retail Media industry, translating intelligence into strategic recommendations for clients and internal teams

- Contribute your vision in meetings with adtech partners to strengthen Mirakl's positioning in the adtech value chain and support the growth of our global Advertising Services initiative

What Mirakl is looking for 

- Master's Degree in Business or Engineering

- 3+ years of experience in retail media, the eCommerce industry, or in a consulting firm with strong exposure to digital advertising and/or marketplace ecosystems

- Solid knowledge of eCommerce, marketplace, and online advertising, with a strong understanding of adtech value chains

- Excellent communication and presentation skills

- Strong client-facing and project management skills

- Highly business-driven with strong analytical skills, thriving in dynamic environments

- Someone eager to thrive in a scaling business environment, contributing to the continuous improvement of the Mirakl Ads Customer Success practice

- Fluency in English is a must-have; German and/or French is a strong asset, given our key markets.

- Self-motivated and energetic, with experience managing multiple internal stakeholders to deliver commercial goals

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

- Willingness to travel internationally

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. 

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews .

title: Senior AI Search engineer(m/f/x)
description:
About commercetools 

Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.

Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together, they are the engine of commerce innovation today.

At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.

Here, the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce but to build your own.

Your Impact 

As a Senior Search Engineer on our Discovery Team , you will build the retrieval layer behind product discovery for some of the world’s most demanding commerce brands.

Search is changing shape. Shoppers type full sentences instead of keywords, and increasingly the client calling our API is an AI agent rather than a person. We are on the path to take our semantic and hybrid retrieval to general availability, and tackling the hard problems: making it fast, affordable, measurably better across enterprise catalogs, and working out what comes after it. You would join that work at every layer, from query understanding down to the vector index and the cost of a single query.

You will: 

- Design and implement search functionalities in a PaaS ecommerce Scala backend.

- Develop in a scalable and multi-tenant architecture.

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems, takes ownership of their work, and can make pragmatic engineering decisions that maximise impact.

title: Senior AI Software Engineer
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

The team 

NiCE Labs (nice.com/nice-labs) is where NiCE explores what's next in AI for customer experience. This role is on AI Innovation, the Labs pillar that builds and validates new AI capabilities through prototypes, so the company can make better product decisions, faster. 

We're a deliberately small, senior team of builders inside NiCE Cognigy, the AI agent platform. We operate in fast iteration cycles: spot an emerging capability, build a working prototype, validate it against real metrics (quality, latency, cost, user impact), and then decide: kill it, iterate, publish it, or hand it off to a product team. Some of our work is public, like the open-sourced Cognigy Platform MCP server; most of it shapes the product roadmap from the inside. 

We hire for product mindset and builder mentality. Everyone on the team takes ideas from zero to working software, shows them to real users, and argues from evidence. 

So, what’s the role all about? 

You'll work at the intersection of frontier AI capabilities and a real enterprise product. The field moves faster than any roadmap can track. Your job is to close that gap: turn new models, protocols, and agent patterns into working systems, prove what matters in realistic scenarios, and produce the insights and reference implementations that let product and engineering teams move with confidence. 

You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity, at home where best practices don't exist yet, and quick to move on when the results point elsewhere. 

How will you make an impact? 

- Build agentic systems and full-stack prototypes end-to-end, shipping a first version in days and learning from real use

- Track the frontier (new models, agent patterns, protocols like MCP) and turn the promising ones into working prototypes rather than slideware 

- Design experiments that show whether a concept holds up, measured in quality, latency, cost, and user impact 

- Work directly with internal users, product managers, and customers to validate concepts early and iterate quickly 

- Turn validated prototypes into reference implementations and write-ups that product teams can build on, then hand off cleanly and move to the next bet 

- Give product and platform teams concrete feedback on where AI capabilities shine and where they fall short 

- Move between initiatives as priorities shift. What you learn on one bet compounds into the next 

Have you got what it takes? 

- Have 4+ years building full-stack software, including things you started from nothing. We weigh what you've shipped more than years on a CV 

- Have shipped LLM-powered systems to production:features real users depended on, not demos or notebooks 

- Understand AI agents below the framework level: message arrays, tool calling, context management, prompt caching. You could build an agent loop from scratch and explain why it works 

- Use AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) as your default way of working, and it makes you measurably faster, not just busier 

- Are full-stackin practice: comfortable taking a prototype from API to demo UI on your own (our stack centers on TypeScript/Node.js and React) 

- Do your best work when the ground is still moving. New territory energises you more than a settled plan 

- Think in user problems first, solutions second 

You will have an advantage if you also have:

- A strong eye for UX/UI: you can make a prototype feel like a product, and you notice when one lacks that eye

- Experience with voice and real-time AI: streaming, speech-to-text/text-to-speech, voice-to-voice models 

- Open-source work on agent tooling (MCP servers, harnesses, evals) 

- Experience designing evaluations for AI systems 

- Background in conversational AI or customer-experience products 

Enjoy NICE-FLEX! 

At NICE, we work according to the NICE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

title: Senior Marketing Manager, EMEA
description:
At Supercell, we craft immersive game worlds that inspire millions. Now, we're looking for a Marketing Manager to bring our games to life across EMEA. 

We are seeking a Senior Marketing Manager to join our International Marketing team and to drive regional marketing campaigns and marketing initiatives across the EMEA region. This role requires strong campaign execution, cross-functional collaboration, and in particular a deep understanding of the DACH cultural landscape. The ideal candidate is an operator with exceptional marketing judgement, capable of turning strategy into outstanding regional execution while proactively identifying opportunities to improve campaigns and regional impact.

What You'll Be Doing

- Own the end-to-end execution of Supercell marketing campaigns, activations, and initiatives across EMEA.

- Translate regional marketing strategy into concrete, high-quality regional go-to-market plans.

- Lead the delivery of campaigns across digital, social, influencer, and partnership channels.

- Manage timelines, budgets, and scopes to ensure campaigns ship on time and at a high quality bar.

- Partner closely with local agencies, game teams, marketing strategists, and creatives to ensure smooth execution.

- Coordinate with creators, agencies, and external partners to deliver integrated campaigns.

- Oversee production across non-owned channels, events, and activations, ensuring consistency and accuracy.

- Track campaign performance and player response, sharing insights with stakeholders.

- Continuously improve execution quality by applying learnings and raising the bar over time.

- Capture learnings, identify execution improvements and proactively recommend ways to improve future campaigns.

What You Have

- Strong experience executing marketing campaigns in EMEA and ideally DACH markets, France and the UK - preferably in gaming, entertainment, or consumer brands.

- Deep understanding of DACH media, culture, and player behavior.

- Hands-on experience across digital and social marketing, including influencer and creator collaborations.

- Familiarity with broader media channels such as TV, CTV, audio, and out-of-home.

- Proven ability to manage complex projects, timelines, and budgets.

- Experience working with international teams across time zones.

- Clear and concise communication skills with strong attention to detail.

- A proactive, adaptable mindset and comfort working in a fast-moving environment.

Would Be Nice if You Also Have

- Experience working on live games or live service products.

- Familiarity with Supercell games or a strong interest in mobile and competitive gaming.

- Experience executing campaigns across EMEA.

Where You'll Be

This is a remote role based in Berlin, Germany.

You'll work closely with teammates in Helsinki, London and partners across the region. This is a globally connected role, with travel expected to Helsinki on a regular basis with occasional international travel.

What Success Looks Like

• First months: You're confidently executing campaigns aligned with global strategy, building strong relationships across teams, and ensuring smooth delivery.

• 6–12 months: Your work is driving measurable impact across awareness, engagement, and player growth. Campaigns feel locally relevant and consistently meet a high quality bar.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read. 

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page. 

––– 

About Supercell 

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars . Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings , and killing lots of projects. 

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture . But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation 

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Not Sure if You Should Apply? 

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

Wenn du außerdem gerne proaktiv und im Team arbeitest, und du jede kleine und große Herausforderung als eine Chance ansiehst, noch besser zu werden – dann sind wir schon ein ganz kleines bisschen verknallt.

DAS IST EVERDROP 

Unsere Mission 💚🌱🌎 

Wir wollen die Welt verändern – gemeinsam mit dir! Die Alltagsprodukte von everdrop helfen den Menschen, ganz einfach ihren ökologischen Fußabdruck im Haushalt zu reduzieren. Im Jahr 2020 sind wir mit unseren Reiniger-Tabs gestartet. Seitdem haben unsere Haushalts- und Pflegeprodukte bereits mehr als 20 Millionen Einweg-Plastikflaschen und Tausende Tonnen unnötige CO2-Emissionen und chemische Rohstoffe eingespart. Seit 2023 sind wir übrigens eine zertifizierte B Corp . Und mit deiner Hilfe wollen wir everdrop aufs nächste Level bringen. Schließ dich unserer Mission an – und hilf uns, einen nachhaltigen Lifestyle so einfach zu machen, dass er zum neuen Standard in unserer Gesellschaft wird.

Unsere Benefits 🍲💪🏡 

- abwechslungsreiche, sinnstiftende und Purpose-getriebene Arbeit 

- großartiger Teamgeist und regelmäßige Team-Events

- zusätzlich 2 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr für eigene umwelt- oder gemeinnützige Projekte ("Green & Social Impact Days”)dein eigenes MacBook, solange du bei everdrop arbeitest 

Our values 💛🏳️‍🌈🤝‍ 

Bei everdrop wollen wir eine Kultur der Inklusion, Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit leben. Das Commitment, die Welt ein bisschen besser zu machen, ist Teil unseres alltäglichen Handelns. Vor allem wollen wir das Bewusstsein für unseren Planeten und für andere Menschen fördern.

Und das ohne Fragen, ohne Rechtfertigungen. Ein weiteres Beispiel: Unsere "Green & Social Impact Days” sind zwei weitere bezahlte freie Tage pro Jahr, die du eigenen Projekten für die Umwelt oder für Deine Community widmen kannst. 
Auch in unserem Hiring-Prozess versuchen wir, so achtsam wie möglich zu sein. 

Wir behandeln jeden Menschen gleich, unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, Aussehen, Sprache, Kultur, Nationalität, Familienstand, sexueller Orientierung oder körperlicher Einschränkung.

title: Senior Social Strategist
description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group , we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role: Senior Social Strategist 

Location: London, England, United Kingdom (2-3 days a week from our London client offices) 

About the role: 

Looking to do the best work of your career? 

Do it with Dove, one of the most respected global brands on social. We're building a team across 15 markets to own Dove's social presence end to end: insight and ideation, platform-native creative, publishing, live ops, and community. From the first idea to the final reply, you'll shape how Dove shows up every day and create work that influences culture. 

You'll move at newsroom speed with rigorous craft—launching ideas that travel, partnering with standout creators, and turning comments into conversations that become cultural moments. The brief is straightforward: make Dove the most culturally relevant brand on social. You'll have the scale, purpose, and creative freedom to make it real. 

If you're motivated by ideas that matter, sharpened by data, and committed to making the internet more positive, this is the place to do it. Bring your craft and your courage. Together we'll build culture—not just content—and do the best work of our careers. 

You'll lead the strategic direction for Dove's social content, bringing together consumer insight, cultural intelligence, platform expertise, and brand purpose to inform creative work that genuinely connects. Based in London with hybrid working arrangements, you'll partner with creative, production, social media, and client teams to ensure every piece of social content is grounded in a clear, compelling strategic rationale. Your understanding of how people discover, consume, and share content on social platforms will be central to keeping Dove's voice distinctive, relevant, and effective. 

We support flexible working and are open to different arrangements. We offer reasonable adjustments throughout the process. 

You'll be the strategic engine behind Dove's social presence, turning audience understanding, cultural signals, and platform data into briefs, frameworks, and recommendations that guide the creative team to produce stand-out work. Working across always-on content, campaign activations, creator partnerships, and reactive cultural moments, you'll ensure Dove's social output is strategically coherent and creatively ambitious. 

We're looking for someone who can think at brand level and act at platform level, someone equally comfortable articulating a long-term content strategy as they are writing a sharp brief for a trending moment on TikTok. Success means social work that is rooted in real insight, aligned with Dove's brand purpose, and demonstrably effective in driving engagement, conversation, and brand affinity. 

What you will be doing: 

- Lead social-first strategy for Dove, developing content strategies, campaign platforms, and always-on frameworks that connect brand purpose to audience behaviour on social 

- Mine consumer, cultural, and category insight to identify opportunities for Dove to show up meaningfully in social conversations and cultural moments 

- Translate platform data, social listening, and audience research into actionable creative briefs that give the team a clear strategic springboard 

- Develop audience and community strategies that deepen Dove's connection with diverse audiences across markets and platforms 

- Partner with the creative team to shape ideas from brief through to execution, providing strategic input that sharpens and elevates the work 

- Collaborate with social media managers to align strategic recommendations with publishing plans, platform priorities, and performance learnings 

- Inform creator and influencer strategy, identifying partnership opportunities that are authentic to Dove's brand and relevant to target audiences 

- Present strategic thinking and campaign recommendations to the Dove brand team with clarity, confidence, and a strong point of view 

- Analyse social performance data and campaign results to refine strategy over time, building a continuous learning loop between insight, creative, and outcomes 

- Stay ahead of social platform evolution, emerging audience behaviours, cultural trends, and competitive activity in beauty and personal care 

- Mentor and develop junior strategists within the studio, building strategic capability and fostering a culture of curiosity and rigour 

- Shape strategic processes and tools for the studio, including briefing templates, insight frameworks, and reporting approaches suited to social-speed workflows 

What you need to be great in this role: 

- 8+ years of strategy experience, with a significant focus on social-first or digital-first work for consumer brands 

- Deep understanding of social platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging channels), including how audiences behave, how content is discovered, and what drives engagement 

- A track record of developing strategies that led to effective, measurable social campaigns or content programmes 

- Experience in beauty, personal care, wellness, or FMCG, with a strong grasp of category dynamics, consumer motivations, and cultural context 

- Proven ability to turn research, data, and cultural observation into sharp, actionable briefs and strategic frameworks 

- Experience working with or briefing content creators and influencer partnerships as part of a social content strategy 

- Confidence presenting strategic recommendations to senior brand stakeholders, with the ability to simplify complexity and build conviction 

- Strong analytical skills, with experience using social listening tools, platform analytics, and audience research to inform strategy 

- A collaborative working style, with experience partnering closely with creative, production, and media teams 

- Experience mentoring or developing other strategists 

- Professional proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus 

- Gen AI and Agentic Thinking: 

- Proficiency with Gen AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, research assistants) to enhance insight generation, trend analysis, audience research, and strategic development 

- Agentic mindset: ability to deconstruct complex strategic challenges, map out the most effective approach, and execute with rigour and adaptability 

- Experience using AI to accelerate research, identify patterns in data, and stress-test strategic hypotheses 

- Understanding of AI capabilities and limitations, with strong critical evaluation of AI-generated insights and a commitment to human judgement and contextual nuance 

- Ability to guide teams in using AI tools responsibly and effectively within the strategic process 

- Qualifications: Formal degrees are welcome but not required. Equivalent experience counts. Experience can be gained through work, study, volunteering, or self-directed learning. 

- Experience working on Dove or Unilever brands 

- Multi-market or global brand strategy experience, with an understanding of adapting social strategy across regions and audiences 

- Experience in a social-specialist, in-house, or embedded agency environment 

- Familiarity with social commerce, community management strategy, or earned media approaches 

- Experience with brand purpose, inclusion, or social impact strategy 

- Knowledge of the evolving regulatory and ethical landscape in beauty marketing

We’re Heidi. 

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

Our perspective on GTM. 

We believe that sales has fundamentally changed in the last 6 months. The repetitive work is automated now: AI does the market research, drafts the emails, summarises and scores the calls.

The last year has taught us that the people who succeed have a blend of the following traits.

- Intellectual dexterity : consultant-like ability to structure and break down a problem into its constituent parts, think from first principles, and self-improve rapidly. Inherent curiosity goes a long way here.

- Natural charisma : can build rapport with anyone. You work out quickly who you're talking to, what they're dealing with and what they actually need, then have the conversation that gets you both somewhere.

- Drive & focus: as AI commoditises intelligence, work ethic and agency matter more. An outlier candidate here is far more productive than the mean than they were two years ago, and the gap keeps widening.

- The mark of humanity: in a world filling up with AI slop, work where you can feel the person behind it stands out. Where the copy, the imagery, and the strategy is indelibly human.

We don't think the talent market has caught up with this shift yet, which is why most of our GTM team came from outside the profession: VC, consulting and creative are common.

- Collaborate with firmware and driver teams to leverage hardware-specific optimizations and ensure seamless integration with the underlying OS.

- Drive engineering excellence by implementing advanced debugging tools, automated performance regression suites, and modern C++ best practices.

- Strong root cause analysis skills, specifically using tools like GDB, Valgrind, or platform-specific profilers.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. The Maneuver Dominance team is building Thunder - an autonomous attack rotorcraft built to fight alongside crewed combat aviation to deliver overwhelming mass effects deep beyond the front lines. The team in London builds the Mission System and the Autonomy that makes aircraft like Thunder work. 

The autonomy is key. It decides how Thunder coordinates with the crewed and uncrewed aircraft around it, how it adapts when the mission changes, how it behaves when the link drops and what it does in the situations no one planned for. Every one of those decisions determines whether the mission succeeds. That is the problem you would own.

You will own real features end to end, shaped with the team, built by you and deployed to customers who depend on them. - Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex systems and established code bases.

- A desire to work on critical software that has a real-world impact.

- A bias for action, extreme ownership, and the drive to see projects through from concept to production.

- Eligible to obtain and maintain an active UKSV Security Clearance

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Your mission 

Brokers play a structural role in how large and very large employers select, negotiate, and manage their health and prévoyance coverage. We're looking for a Broker Partnerships Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with the brokers who operate in the Enterprise segment, turning Alan into a trusted, credible, and commercially compelling partner for those actors, and supporting our Enterprise Sales and Key Account Management teams.

⭐ Location 

On-site in Paris , Île-de-France.

What makes this role genuinely unique

- You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health insurance companies builds its relationships with the brokers operating in the large and very large employer segment across France, and beyond.

- You'll have real ownership from day one and operate at the highest levels of the broker market.

- You'll shape Alan’s broker strategy and execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability. The playbook is yours to define and scale.

- You'll work directly with Alan's Enterprise Sales, Key Account Management, Insurance, and Executive Leadership.

⭐ Your role 

Relationships & Presence 

- Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with the brokers that sit between us and the largest employers in our markets (whether private or public), at senior and managing director level.

- Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors, and design Alan's engagement strategy.

- Be the consistent Alan voice that brokers recognize: someone who shows up, follows through, and is known as easy to deal with without giving away what shouldn't be given.

Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Commercial work 

- Be a partner to our Enterprise Sales and KAM teams on every broker situation: drive strategic decisions deal by deal and turn ecosystem knowledge into commercial leverage.

- Introduce the right broker contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle, transforming relationship capital into pipeline access on large and very large accounts.

- Share Alan's value and positioning with broker partners to help them understand, represent, and actively promote Alan within their client portfolios.

- Hold the line on our non-negotiables while finding creative ways to make the collaboration work for both sides.

Sector Engagement & Anticipation 

- Follow the broker market at deal level and ecosystem level: who is growing, who is consolidating, where portfolio shifts are happening, and what it means for Alan's pipeline and positioning.

- Be a sharp, early internal voice on where the broker market is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy, including on consolidation, regulation, and competitive dynamics.

Build & Scale 

- Knowledge base: Build and maintain a knowledge library on broker positions, portfolio footprints, engagement history, and contractual frameworks shared with Enterprise Sales and KAM teams to increase win rates.

- Framework & tools: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our broker engagement and contract documentation (conventions de courtage, commission tracking, data sharing agreements).

- Collaboration: Share best practices with the broader Enterprise & Commercial team and contribute proven methodologies to their scaled commercial operations.

- Market intelligence: Provide competitive intelligence on how brokers position Alan vs. incumbents, how they advise clients on insurer selection, and where we are perceived as "difficult to work with" — and feed that back into product, pricing, and GTM strategy.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for? 

You’ll be a great fit for this opportunity if you: 

- Have at least 8 years of total experience working with or inside the broker ecosystem: at a broker or in an external partnership or distribution role at a health insurer or mutuelle

- Have legitimate credibility at senior broker level: ability to engage managing director and senior leadership at major brokers as a peer, built through a personal representative past or years of substantive deal-level engagement on the insurer or employer side

- Have deep knowledge of the broker ecosystem in the large and very large employer segment: how brokers operate, how they are compensated, how they advise clients, and how they influence insurer selection at this scale

- Have deep understanding of health and prévoyance insurance: the technical dimension (garanties, gestion, régimes, prévoyance) must be native, not learned on the job

- Have proven ability to build trust with broker counterparts from the insurer or employer side: long-game, trustworthy, discreet, commercially disciplined

- Demonstrate outstanding stakeholder management: calm, ego-free, able to represent Alan substantively without making it about yourself and equally able to hold firm positions internally when sales pressure pushes toward broker accommodation beyond our framework

- Demonstrate commercial impact from prior broker-related work: broker relationships that translated into material deal flow, pipeline access, or portfolio migration

- Are a self-starter: comfortable building from scratch in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with limited process and real autonomy

- Are ego-free and lever-minded: you accelerate others, you don't seek the spotlight

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the F-H level range . 

🙌 Perks & Benefits 

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer: 

- Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. 

- Flexible office with hybrid setup . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ

- All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

- Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish.

- Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). 

- Transport . Generous transit benefit

- Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

- Personal growth through coaching : At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture . 

- Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. 

Important note: we hire people, not roles. 

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. 

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

- Account and bank reconciliation: maintain clean, up-to-date reconciliations across all balance sheet accounts and entities on a daily basis;

- Contribute to finance transformation and system improvements: identify manual or repetitive tasks and collaborate with Financial Data to drive automation and reduce closing friction over time ; translate new business streams and P&L lines into accounting (acting as an interface between business teams and Finance)

⭐️ Qualifications ⭐️ 

Experience and technical skills 

- 4 to 6 years of accounting experience minimum, in an accounting firm or in-house at a fast-paced startup/scale-up

- Languages: full fluency in French and English

- Deep command of French accounting standards: VAT rules, URSSAF declarations, bank reconciliation, general ledger management, and month-end close processes

- Proven ability to own a closing cycle end-to-end, including identifying and resolving issues independently

- Hands-on experience with an ERP (NetSuite is a strong plus)

Mindset and soft skills

- Process-driven: you naturally question how things are done and come with concrete ideas to improve them

- Curious about automation and tooling; comfortable working in a data-driven environment

- Clear communicator: you know when to move independently and when to escalate

For this role we are looking to hire within the B0-C0 level range .

Notre ambition est de repenser la santé au travail pour améliorer l'impact sur la vie des salariés et l'expérience des professionnels de santé, en s'appuyant sur les moyens technologiques d'Alan. 

Notre premier centre médical a ouvert ses portes au 117 Quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) et ce n'est que le début !

👉 Pour en savoir plus sur le quotidien chez Prévenir, c'est ici

Vous êtes médecin du travail référent sur un portefeuille d'entreprises adhérentes, vos responsabilités sont les suivantes: 

- Coordonner les trois missions des SPSTI (suivi individuel, action en milieu de travail, prévention de la désinsertion professionnelle) sur votre périmètre d'entreprises adhérentes, avec une équipe pluridisciplinaire que vous animez : IDEST, ASST, IPRP

- Capacité à construire une relation de confiance avec salariés et adhérents

description:

Role Overview 

Harvey's law school program has reached 50+ US schools in year one. Now we are taking it global, and we need the right person to lead that charge expanding in the EMEA, and APAC markets.

As International Law School Manager, EMEA you will own the full lifecycle of Harvey's academic partnerships across your markets — signing new schools, building faculty and dean relationships, running trainings, launching ambassador programs, and driving the curriculum and on-campus embeds that make Harvey helpful to each institution with whom we work.

You will start by taking over account management of existing EMEA partner schools and then look to sign and expand our presence across the region. You report directly to the Head of Legal Partnerships, Law Schools (New York).

What You'll Do 

- School Partnerships: Lead outreach, relationship development, and onboarding for EMEA law schools — from flagship institutions to smaller schools.

- Market Expansion: Build the playbook for Harvey’s Academic presence in each new EMEA/International market together with Law School Lead; execute new international launches throughout the year.

- Cross-functional: Partner with Harvey's GTM commercial team, legal engineering, and marketing on in-market events, firm-to-school pipeline, and co-activation opportunities.

- Account Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for every school in your portfolio — owning relationships with faculty, library staff, student organizations, and administrators across each partner institution.

- Training & Enablement: Run all product training, demos, workspace setup, and activation events for your portfolio — including semester-start all-hands pushes, large-group faculty workshops, and 1:1 curriculum advisory sessions. Draw on the global Content Specialist and CS Lead for materials and operational support.

- Ambassador Programs: Launch and own the EMEA student ambassador and faculty champion networks, adapting the US/UK model for European legal education norms.

- Curriculum Advisory: Advise faculty and curriculum committees on how to integrate Harvey into courses, clinics, and legal writing programs — doing the hands-on work that makes academic embeds real.

What You Have 

Ideal candidates for the Law School Manager, EMEA role at Harvey can demonstrate comfort and experience with the following:

- Law degree preferred — deep understanding of how EMEA law schools are structured and how faculty, students, and administrators operate

- Strong experience in legal practice, legal tech, legal innovation, or academic programs — experience in a client-facing or externally-facing role is a strong differentiator

- Proven ability to manage a portfolio of relationships in a high-growth or startup environment — you keep up with a high volume without losing account depth

- Comfortable running product trainings and demos for audiences ranging from first-year students to senior faculty and deans

- Entrepreneurial and self-directed — you build from scratch, operate without a playbook, and hold yourself accountable across multiple markets

- Strong organizational instincts — you can manage many schools across multiple countries and time zones.

- Based in London, Paris, or Madrid, 3 days a week in office; Willing and able to travel across Europe, US, and other international jurisdictions for work.

title: CDI - MODELISTE FLOU ET/OU TAILLEUR (H/F)
description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS 

Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. 

Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. 

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière). 

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street). 

VOTRE ROLE 

En lien direct avec le studio de création, vous traduisez les croquis et les intentions du directeur artistique en volumes et en premiers patronages. Vous êtes garant(e) de la silhouette, des proportions et du bien-aller des pièces de la Maison.

VOS MISSIONS 

- Interpréter les croquis et les références du studio pour créer les patronages

- Travailler les volumes en coupe à plat et en moulage

- Réaliser et modifier les toiles

- Suivre le montage des prototypes avec l'atelier

- Animer les essayages et proposer des ajustements de coupe et de proportions

- Faire évoluer les patronages jusqu'à la validation finale

- Transmettre au bureau d'études des modèles et des dossiers techniques complets

VOTRE PROFIL 

- Formation en modélisme (BTS, DMA, ESMOD, AICP, Chambre Syndicale ou équivalent)

- 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en tant que modéliste dans une maison de luxe ou de prêt-à-porter haut de gamme

- Spécialisation flou et/ou tailleur, avec une bonne connaissance des matières associées (soie, crêpe, lainages, tissus structurés…)

- Maîtrise de la coupe à plat et du moulage ; la connaissance d'un logiciel de CAO est un plus

- Sensibilité créative et bonne compréhension de l'univers de la Maison

- Sens du volume, du détail et du bien-aller

- Capacité à échanger avec le studio et à tenir les délais de collection

Ce poste est basé dans le 8ème arrondissement de Paris

title: WHOLESALE DIRECTOR EMEA & APAC (Maternity Leave Cover)

description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

We’re looking for an Senior Account Executive to grow our footprint across France. You’ll be at the forefront of introducing Tandem’s clinician copilot to providers, partners, and health systems - shaping how we scale across France

This is a pivotal role where you’ll forge high-impact partnerships across the care ecosystem, from provider networks and EHR vendors to resellers and health insurers. You’ll act as a market expert, relationship builder, and operator all in one.

What you will do

- Identify, initiate, and manage key relationships across the healthcare landscape in France.

- Open doors with provider groups, EHR vendors, system integrators, payors, and commercial resellers to accelerate Tandem’s reach and adoption.

- Pitch, negotiate, and close deals that deliver strategic value, working closely with legal, product, and commercial teams to get contracts across the line.

- Represent Tandem externally in meetings, events, and conferences, positioning us as a trusted digital health partner.

- Bring the voice of the market back into Tandem, sharing insights that inform product development, regulatory priorities, and local go-to-market strategy.

- Help build the customer success and support infrastructure that ensures our partners thrive with Tandem.

What You Bring

- Proven experience with healthcare partnerships, sales, or business development - ideally in health-tech, med-tech, with familiarity of the hospital ecosystem

- A strong track record of closing strategic partnerships in complex, regulated environments with providers, EHRs, or pharmaceutical companies.

- Deep knowledge of the French hospital ecosystem - from payors and providers to health IT vendors and regional nuances.

- A strong local network and ability to build trusted relationships across stakeholder groups.

- Comfortable navigating clinical, commercial, and technical conversations.

- Fluent in French and English, with excellent communication skills.

- Independent operator with the ability to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams.

- Passion for improving healthcare delivery through thoughtful, impactful innovation.

Bonus Points

- Experience working with or selling into EHR providers, health systems, or care delivery platforms.

- Background in medtech, digital health, healthcare

- Familiarity with EU/French regulatory and compliance environments.

- Experience in startup or high-growth environments, especially launching new markets.

What we offer

- Competitive salary, reviewed as you grow, plus stock options

- 30 days of holiday

- Paid parental leave

- €1,000 annual health & wellbeing budget, plus mental-health support whenever you need it

- A real learning budget and internal growth paths - build your career without leaving Tandem

- Fully AI native company - let our agents do the grunt work

- Two company off-sites a year, plus a team budget for the things that bring you closer

- State of the art office in the heart of Paris, and your choice of IT equipment

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This is a full-time role based in Paris, France. You’ll travel regularly - either to meet clinicians around France or to collaborate with our team in Stockholm.

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

- Screening interview with Talent Acquisition 

- First interview with our Country Director in France

- Working Day - Join us in the Paris office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.
