title: Finance Business Partner
description:
About Everfield 

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About the Role 

This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses.

You'll be accountable end-to-end for the accounting integrity of your portfolio: closing the books accurately, building and leading a team of local finance experts to meet French statutory and regulatory requirements, and making sure every number that reaches Everfield's leadership is right and on time. But the job doesn't stop at accuracy. You'll sit next to Business Unit Leaders as their financial conscience and commercial sparring partner - coaching them on the numbers, challenging their growth plans, and pushing them to allocate resources where they'll actually compound.

Everfield deliberately gives this role more scope than a typical FP&A or controller seat carries at this career stage. You'll run the accounting, build and lead the regional finance team, and shape how each business thinks about growth - the full stack, across multiple companies.

What You'll Do 

Own the numbers 

• Be accountable for the accuracy and timeliness of monthly reporting (management P&L, KPIs, operating metrics) for each business in your portfolio - not just its preparation.

• Build and manage a team of local financial experts to meet French statutory and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Guide each business's finance and accounting team through migration onto Everfield's NetSuite instance.

• Own the accuracy and timeliness of the underlying accounting work behind every number you report.

• Build and defend annual budgets and rolling forecasts, incorporating strategic initiatives and long-term expectations.

• Prepare Quarterly Update Review (QUR) packs for Everfield's CEO, CFO, and COO.

Drive the growth agenda 

• Coach Business Unit Leaders on financial acumen - make sure they understand and consistently apply the Everfield ratios, not just report against them.

• Challenge and support Business Unit Leaders in applying Everfield's prescribed revenue system to their business.

• Help each business spot operating efficiencies, report headcount accurately, and manage overhead with intent.

• Partner with Business Unit Leaders on charting expense management and aligning resources toward growth, not just cost control.

• Play an active role in integration of newly acquired businesses - systems, data, and reporting design, alongside the Integration Director and Head of BI.

• Partner with your Strategic Business Partner (SBP) counterpart on the day-to-day relationship with each business in your region.

Who We're Looking For 

• An ambitious problem-solver who wants this role to be a stepping stone – experience on the path towards a CFO or Controller of a larger group of companies, or of a larger standalone business.

• Strong technical grounding in accounting practices and controls - you can run a clean close and hold a third-party provider to a standard, not just review their output.

• Commercial instinct to match: you can sit across from a Business Unit Leader and challenge their growth plan, not just report on whether they hit it.

• A completed university education plus a professional finance qualification (CA/ACA/CIMA or equivalent).

• 5+ years in Business Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering.

• Ability to lead and build a team of regional finance specialists.

• Comfort operating in a decentralised, multi-entity, PE-backed environment - you'll manage stakeholders across businesses at very different stages of maturity.

• Fluent in English and French; effective communicator at every level of an organisation, from bookkeeper to CEO.

• Ideally, a background in fast-growing technology or SaaS companies.

• Willingness to travel occasionally.

What We Offer 

• Attractive salary package with performance-based bonus.

• Remote flexibility.

• A collaborative team culture based on respect, ownership, and trust.

• Access to international experts within the Everfield ecosystem - accelerate your personal and professional growth.

• Regular team events and company celebrations.

Interview Process 

Here's what to expect and who you'll meet during the recruitment process:

• First interview with Talent Acquisition Manager (0.5 h)

• Second interview with Hiring Manager (1.0 h)

• Third interview with Group Finance representatives (1.0 h)

title: ML Engineer - Power
description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 

Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. 

About the Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Kpler, you will play a key role in developing and deploying predictive models that power our global commodity, energy, and maritime intelligence platforms. Working closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Product teams, you will bridge the gap between machine learning experimentation and production-grade software delivery. Your work will directly transform complex data flows into real-time, actionable insights that help world-leading trading firms, industrial leaders, and analysts make critical decisions.

Key Responsibilities 

- 
Architect and deploy ML pipelines: Design, build, and maintain production-grade machine learning workflows and microservices for power market forecasting and electricity grid modeling.

- 
Bridge research and engineering: Transition statistical and machine learning prototypes from initial experimentation into scalable, production-ready Python applications.

- 
Manage time-series and event data systems: Design and optimize database schemas in PostgreSQL to handle high-throughput time-series data, event streams, and normalization routines.

- 
Implement robust MLOps practices: Establish automated model training, backtesting, evaluation, tuning, and feature/model versioning standards across deployments.

- 
Drive data engineering quality: Construct clean ingestion and transformation pipelines, ensuring high integrity, validation, and low-latency access across analytical models.

- 
Champion software excellence: Write modular, well-tested Python code, actively participating in peer code reviews, CI/CD automation, and Agile delivery processes.

Experience & Background 

What you'll need (Must-haves)

- 
Software engineering foundation: Approximately two to five years of experience as a data-focused software engineer.

- 
Python mastery: Significant experience working with large production Python codebases, rather than working exclusively in notebooks.

- 
Domain knowledge: Deep understanding of electricity-grid fundamentals, including generation, transmission, and electricity markets.

- 
Data engineering & databases: Experience in data engineering, including working with PostgreSQL or similar databases, database design, data normalisation, and managing time-series and event data.

- 
DS & ML research rigor: Proven experience in data science and machine learning research, encompassing statistics, hypothesis testing, model training, evaluation, backtesting, tuning, and model selection.

- 
MLOps & versioning: Practical experience in machine learning engineering, specifically including model and feature versioning.

- 
Engineering practices & communication: Confidence working with Git, code reviews, and Agile methodologies, supported by strong written and spoken English.

Nice-to-haves

- 
Cloud platforms: Experience deploying ML workloads on AWS or GCP using Docker and Kubernetes.

- 
Workflow orchestration: Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, or MLflow.

- 
Streaming technologies: Exposure to real-time streaming architectures (e.g., Apache Kafka).

title: Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer
description:
About Us

Base360.ai is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for an ambitious Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them.

If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle.

You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.

Your Mission

Understand Customer Problems

Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving.

Build Products End-to-End

Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production.

Create Intuitive User Experiences

Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Features

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Connect the Ecosystem

Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Solve Real Operational Problems

Build solutions for:

- Real-time reservation and availability synchronization

- Dynamic pricing intelligence

- Smart lock access and key management

- Automated guest communication across channels

- Guest check-in and upsell journeys

- Operational forecasting

- Cleaning and maintenance automation

- Owner reporting and financial workflows

- AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Measure and Improve

Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes.

Build for Scale

Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

- Python

- FastAPI

- React

- TypeScript

- Supabase

- PostgreSQL

- AWS

- Serverless architecture

- OpenAI APIs

- Twilio

- Stripe

- Docker

- GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

- Strong experience building and shipping production software

- The ability to work across frontend and backend systems

- Experience with React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, or similar technologies

- Strong understanding of APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud architecture

- A product mindset and curiosity about why users need a feature

- Good judgment around usability, scope, and technical trade-offs

- The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a practical, working solution

- Confidence working directly with customers, designers, and founders

- The ability to work independently and own outcomes

- Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency

- A bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating

Bonus points for experience with:

- Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems

- Multi-tenant SaaS platforms

- Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations

- AI agents and workflow automation

- Product analytics and experimentation

- Event-driven architectures

- Supabase

- AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months:

- You've shipped features that property managers actively use

- Core short-term rental workflows are automated through products you've built

- Customers spend less time on manual administration and repetitive tasks

- Complex workflows become easier to understand and complete

- Integrations move reservations, availability, payments, and operational data reliably

- AI-powered features become part of customers’ everyday operations

- Customer feedback and usage data consistently inform your product decisions

- Your work helps operators grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Own the Product Outcome

Help decide what to build, how it should work, and how to measure its success. Take responsibility for features from the first conversation through ongoing improvement.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai .

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across product, software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

This Role Is Not For You If

- You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment

- You want a narrowly defined role with limited customer or product involvement

- You need detailed specifications before you can make progress

- You avoid ownership and accountability

- You consider a feature finished without checking whether it solves the user’s problem

We're looking for someone who wants to help build the AI operating system for the short-term rental industry.

description:
NOTRE ONG : 

Handicap International / Humanité & Inclusion (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et vulnérabilisées, elle agit et témoigne pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels et améliorer leurs conditions de vie. Elle s’engage à promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Depuis sa création en 1982, HI a mis en place des programmes de développement dans plus de 60 pays et intervient dans de nombreuses situations d’urgence avec ses plus de 3500 collaborateurs. 

Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. 

Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux premiers entretiens.

CONTEXTE : 

Vous intégrez le Service Contrôle de gestion Siège et Associations Nationales (AN) , dont le rôle est d'accompagner les directions et associations nationales dans le pilotage financier, budgétaire et analytique de leurs activités. Il assure la production des reportings financiers, la consolidation des données du réseau, le suivi des risques financiers et l'amélioration continue des outils et processus de gestion.

- la valorisation et la fiabilisation des données financières,

- et le pilotage financier d'un portefeuille comprenant prioritairement l'Association Nationale UK. 

Cette articulation vise à renforcer la qualité de l'information, l'automatisation des reportings et l'aide à la décision.

L’objectif est de structurer, fiabiliser, analyser et mettre à disposition les données utiles au pilotage, tout en assurant le suivi budgétaire, financier et des risques du périmètre confié. title: Strategic Tech Partnerships Manager
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision 

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane 

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1300 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

À propos du rôle 

Chez Pennylane, les partenariats jouent un rôle clé dans notre capacité à accompagner les cabinets comptables et leurs clients avec une expérience financière toujours plus intégrée.

En tant que Strategic Partnerships Manager , vous serez responsable du développement d’un portefeuille resserré de partenaires stratégiques dans plusieurs catégories de produits. Votre mission sera de transformer ces partenariats en véritables leviers de croissance, en combinant animation commerciale, adoption produit et développement de notre écosystème.

Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec les équipes Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success afin d’aligner les intérêts de Pennylane et de ses partenaires, et de générer une croissance durable chez nos clients communs.

Vos responsabilités 

- Animer et développer un portefeuille de partenaires stratégiques 

- Gérer un portefeuille de 20 à 30 partenaires technologiques. 

- Construire une relation de confiance avec les interlocuteurs clés de vos partenaires : équipes commerciales, marketing, produit, direction et customer success.

- Définir, avec chaque partenaire, une stratégie de développement adaptée à son potentiel, à son niveau de maturité et à ses priorités business.

- Mettre en place des rituels de pilotage réguliers : business reviews, points d’avancement, plans d’action et suivi des engagements réciproques.

- Identifier les opportunités d’upsell, de cross-sell et d’élargissement de la collaboration.

- Générer du business grâce au co-selling 

- Co-construire et exécuter des business plans annuels avec les partenaires prioritaires.

- Développer des motions de co-selling efficaces entre les équipes commerciales de Pennylane et celles de nos partenaires.

- Identifier, qualifier et faire progresser les opportunités commerciales issues de l’écosystème partenaire.

- Structurer les processus de génération, de partage et de suivi des leads et opportunités.

- Collaborer avec les équipes Sales pour accélérer la conversion des opportunités et maximiser le MRR généré.

- Organiser des actions commerciales communes : campagnes ciblées, événements, webinars, contenus ou opérations de prospection conjointes.

- Accélérer l’adoption produit et l’usage chez les clients communs 

- Suivre la santé des intégrations et des parcours communs entre Pennylane et ses partenaires.

- Stimuler l’adoption de nos intégrations et l’augmentation du nombre d’utilisateurs actifs chez les clients communs.

- Identifier les freins à l’activation, à l’usage ou à la rétention, puis coordonner les plans d’action avec les équipes concernées.

- Mettre en place des indicateurs de suivi de l’usage et partager régulièrement les analyses avec les partenaires.

- Contribuer à améliorer l’expérience client sur l’ensemble du parcours, de l’acquisition à l’utilisation quotidienne des solutions connectées.

- Devenir l’expert de vos catégories de produits 

- Développer une compréhension approfondie des catégories de produits et des marchés couverts.

- Devenir le référent interne et externe sur les acteurs, tendances, cas d’usage et dynamiques concurrentielles de votre périmètre.

- Comprendre la stratégie produit et commerciale de chaque partenaire afin d’identifier les opportunités d’alignement avec Pennylane.

- Faire remonter les besoins et retours du marché aux équipes Product, Engineering et Marketing.

- Contribuer à prioriser les évolutions d’intégration et les initiatives communes avec les partenaires.

- Aider les équipes internes à mieux comprendre la valeur et le positionnement des solutions partenaires.

- Mener une chasse stratégique ciblée 

- Cartographier l’écosystème français et identifier les acteurs stratégiques encore absents de notre portefeuille.

- Qualifier les partenaires présentant le plus fort potentiel pour Pennylane, nos clients et notre stratégie produit.

- Construire des approches d’engagement personnalisées auprès de ces acteurs.

- Négocier et signer de nouveaux partenariats à fort impact.

- Développer progressivement ces nouvelles relations jusqu’à leur activation commerciale et produit.

Vos indicateurs de performance 

- Croissance du MRR sourced et influenced sur vos catégories de produits.

- Nombre d’utilisateurs actifs connectés via les intégrations partenaires.

- Taux d’adoption et d’utilisation des intégrations chez les clients communs.

- Taux de rétention, notamment la Net Revenue Retention , des clients utilisant les intégrations dédiées.

- Nombre de partenaires accompagnés avec succès du Tier Silver au Tier Gold .

- Contribution des partenaires aux objectifs de croissance de Pennylane.

- Nombre de nouveaux partenaires stratégiques signés et activés.

- Satisfaction et niveau d’engagement des partenaires prioritaires.

Le profil recherché 

- Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en partenariats stratégiques, business development, account management ou écosystème SaaS .

- Vous avez déjà géré des portefeuilles de partenaires ou de comptes stratégiques avec des objectifs de croissance mesurables.

- Vous êtes à l’aise dans des environnements impliquant plusieurs interlocuteurs et équipes : Sales, Product, Marketing, Customer Success et Direction.

- Vous savez construire une relation de confiance tout en gardant une forte orientation business et résultats.

- Vous avez une bonne compréhension des mécanismes de co-selling, de génération de leads et de développement commercial indirect.

- Vous êtes capable de structurer un plan d’action, de prioriser vos efforts et de piloter plusieurs initiatives en parallèle.

- Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’analyse de données et le suivi de KPIs commerciaux et produit.

- Vous savez évoluer dans des contextes complexes, avec des cycles de décision parfois longs et plusieurs parties prenantes.

- Vous avez d’excellentes capacités de communication, de négociation et de présentation.

- Vous êtes fluent en français et en anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Les qualités qui feront la différence 

- Orientation résultats : vous aimez transformer une relation partenaire en impact concret pour le business.

- Esprit stratégique : vous savez prendre de la hauteur, identifier les bons leviers et construire une vision commune.

- Leadership transversal : vous êtes capable d’embarquer des équipes sans lien hiérarchique direct.

- Culture produit : vous aimez comprendre les usages, les intégrations et les problématiques des utilisateurs.

- Rigueur et autonomie : vous structurez votre activité et assurez un suivi fiable de vos engagements.

- Sens du collectif : vous privilégiez la collaboration et cherchez à construire des relations durables, en interne comme en externe.

- Curiosité sectorielle : vous aimez comprendre un marché, ses acteurs et ses évolutions.

Processus de recrutement 

- Entretien RH avec Nathalie, Talent Acquisition - 30 mins

- Entretien Manager avec avec Chloé - Partner Team Lead - Connectivity - 45 mins

- Étude de cas à réaliser chez soi, suivie d’un débriefing avec Chloé + 1 membre de l'équipe - 1h

- Last Round avec Arnaud - General Manager Connectivity - 45-mins

- Team Fit avec l'équipe Tech partnerships + Marketing - 30 mins

Nous tenons également à souligner que nous adhérons pleinement aux principes de diversité, d’équité et d’inclusion, et que nous mettons tout en œuvre pour créer un environnement sûr et inclusif. 
Nous nous engageons à offrir l’égalité des chances en matière d’emploi, sans distinction de genre, d’orientation sexuelle, d’origine, de handicap ou de toute autre caractéristique qui fait de vous ce que vous êtes. Au contraire, la diversité rend notre lieu de travail encore plus agréable.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins enclines à postuler que d’autres si elles ont l’impression de ne pas répondre à l’ensemble des critères.

Si vous hésitez, nous vous encourageons à postuler : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d’une collaboration enrichissante et durable.

Que faisons-nous pour faciliter votre vie professionnelle ? 

🌴 Quel que soit votre lieu de travail, vous bénéficierez de 25 jours de congés payés par Pennylane

💵 Vous bénéficierez d’une rémunération compétitive

📈 Vous recevrez des actions de l’entreprise pour profiter d’une part de la réussite que vous construisez avec nous

🏡 Vous disposerez d’un budget pour transformer votre domicile en un espace de travail plus confortable, ainsi que d’une allocation mensuelle pour travailler dans un espace de coworking quand vous le souhaitez

⛹️ Grâce à notre partenaire Gymlib, vous aurez accès à 8 000 salles de sport en Europe et à plus de 300 activités liées au bien-être

🇬🇧 Vous aurez accès à Busuu pour perfectionner votre anglais ou votre français

💻 Vous disposerez des derniers équipements Apple

🏢 En fonction des équipes et des exigences du poste, vous pourrez travailler à distance

Si vous êtes basé en France, vous bénéficierez d’un contrat de travail français conforme à la réglementation française, en plus des avantages suivants : 6 à 12 jours de RTT, 5 semaines de congés payés, des crédits repas (Swile), une couverture santé Alan Blue et des événements réguliers dans les villes où les Pennylaners sont les plus nombreux (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

Nous travaillons à étendre ces derniers avantages à nos collaborateurs basés hors de France, mais cela peut s’avérer plus complexe selon les pays.

Informations importantes pour les candidats 

Les tentatives d’escroquerie à l’embauche sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilants lors de vos échanges.

Postulez uniquement via les canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres d’emploi publiées sur nos plateformes officielles (site Carrières, pages partenaires officielles).

Vérifiez toujours l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses e-mail professionnelles avec les domaines @ pennylane.com ou ext@ pennylane.com 

Nous ne vous demanderon

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez Pennylane ? 

L’ANECS et le CJEC réunissent une génération qui contribue déjà à façonner le cabinet de demain : collaborateurs en cabinet, stagiaires experts-comptables, mémorialistes, jeunes diplômés, créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes experts-comptables installés.
Tous ne créeront pas leur cabinet. Beaucoup évolueront au sein de structures existantes et participeront directement à leur transformation : nouvelles pratiques de production, développement de nouvelles missions, adoption de l’IA, structuration commerciale, attractivité des équipes et amélioration de la productivité.
Pour les membres en phase d’installation, de reprise ou déjà installés, les enjeux sont très concrets : choisir les bons outils, développer leur activité, structurer les équipes et les missions, gagner en efficacité et identifier de nouveaux leviers de croissance. Pennylane a un rôle à jouer au-delà de celui d’un simple éditeur : devenir un partenaire de développement business et de productivité pour les cabinets qui se créent, se transforment et grandissent.

L’ANECS et le CJEC constituent un écosystème national et régional dense, avec près de 50 sections. Les bureaux se renouvellent en alternance, une année sur deux, ce qui demande une animation relationnelle continue et une transmission structurée entre les équipes sortantes et entrantes.

Ce poste est clé pour : 

- construire une préférence durable pour Pennylane auprès de la nouvelle génération de la profession comptable ;

- accompagner les membres dans leurs enjeux de carrière, de développement de cabinet et de transformation des pratiques ;

- transformer les partenariats, événements et prises de parole en contacts qualifiés, signaux d’intention et opportunités ;

- sécuriser une relation continue avec les instances nationales et les sections régionales ;

- faire de Pennylane un partenaire reconnu pour développer le business et la productivité des cabinets.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? 

- Tu construis et animes la relation entre Pennylane et l’écosystème ANECS-CJEC. Ta mission est de faire de Pennylane un partenaire de référence pour celles et ceux qui font évoluer la profession comptable : futurs experts-comptables, collaborateurs en cabinet, créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes installés.

- Tu combines une forte présence terrain, l’animation d’une communauté active, la construction de contenus utiles et un travail étroit avec l’équipe commerciale. Tu développes une connaissance fine des membres, de leurs parcours et de leurs besoins afin d’identifier les moments pertinents pour activer Pennylane : évolution professionnelle, projet d’installation, reprise, recrutement, développement de nouvelles missions ou besoin de gagner en productivité.

- Tu pilotes la relation nationale avec l’ANECS et le CJEC, animes le réseau des sections régionales et assures la continuité de la relation lors du renouvellement alterné des bureaux.

- Tu conçois et portes les activations les plus pertinentes : événements, ateliers, contenus, formats communautaires et prises de parole.

- En lien étroit avec l’équipe commerciale, tu contribues aux initiatives auprès des créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes cabinets. Tu développes une communauté qualifiée, identifies les signaux d’intention et assures la bonne transmission des opportunités aux équipes commerciales, au bon moment dans le parcours de chaque contact.

- Tu seras rattaché·e à Cyril Chanson, Manager Partenariats – Profession Comptable, et travailleras au quotidien avec les équipes Sales, Marketing, Enablement, Éducation et Événementiel.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 
Pilotage du partenariat national — 20 %

- Porter la relation nationale avec l’ANECS et le CJEC de bout en bout : convention annuelle, gouvernance, budget, négociation des contreparties et plan d’activation.

- Gérer le budget sponsoring et événementiel, estimé à environ35 k€ par an, et en suivre le retour sur investissement.

- Sécuriser puis activer les contreparties les plus utiles : visibilité, contenus, prises de parole, accès aux sections, formats exclusifs et opportunités de qualification.

- Construire une relation de confiance avec les instances nationales et assurer la continuité du partenariat dans la durée.

Animation du réseau et présence terrain — 30 %

- Animer la communauté ANECS-CJEC au niveau national et régional, avec une présence régulière auprès des sections, de leurs bureaux et de leurs membres.

- Maintenir un mapping fiable des élus, ambassadeurs et relais locaux ; préparer activement les passations entre bureaux sortants et entrants.

- Construire et exécuter un plan de présence terrain ambitieux et priorisé : congrès, Estivales, DEC After, soirées jeunes inscrits, Olympiades, Journées des Jeunes Inscrits, tables rondes et événements locaux.

- Concevoir des activations utiles et engageantes : ateliers, témoignages, formats de networking, démonstrations, échanges entre pairs et prises de parole.

- Assurer le suivi post-événement : qualification des contacts, activation de la communauté, transmission des signaux pertinents aux équipes commerciales et partage des apprentissages terrain.

- Travailler avec la responsable événementielle sur la préparation et l’organisation des événements prioritaires.

Initiatives auprès des créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes cabinets — 20 %

- Co-construire avec l’équipe commerciale les initiatives destinées aux créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes cabinets : ciblage, calendrier, offres, contenus, événements et parcours d’activation.

- Apporter une connaissance fine des parcours, besoins et signaux d’intention observés au sein de la communauté ANECS-CJEC.

- Identifier les moments où Pennylane peut créer de la valeur : installation, reprise, structuration d’équipe, choix des outils, développement de nouvelles missions, vente, IA ou productivité.

- Qualifier et transmettre les contacts et projets à fort potentiel à l’équipe commerciale selon un processus partagé.

- Suivre, avec l’équipe commerciale, la contribution de ces initiatives au pipeline et au MRR attribuables au canal.

Stratégie d’activation, contenus et communauté — 20 %

- Définir et animer une stratégie de communauté combinant présence physique, rendez-vous digitaux, contenus, email, social media et relais locaux.

- Concevoir des formats utiles aux membres à chaque étape de leur parcours : réussite du diplôme, découverte des formes d’exercice, installation, reprise, développement ou modernisation d’un cabinet.

- Développer des contenus et événements autour des enjeux qui transforment les cabinets : IA, productivité, nouvelles missions, organisation, recrutement, développement commercial et expérience client.

- Formaliser les besoins, briefer l’équipe Enablement et coordonner la production des contenus.

- Construire, segmenter et animer dans la durée une base de communauté qualifiée, dans le respect des règles de consentement et de gestion des données.

Pilotage de la performance et veille — 10 %

- Suivre la couverture du réseau, les contacts générés, la qualité des leads, l’engagement de la communauté, les signaux détectés, le pipeline influencé, le MRR attribuable, le budget et le ROI.

- Produire un reporting trimestriel présentant les résultats, les apprentissages terrain et les arbitrages de priorisation recommandés.

- Assurer une veille sur les initiatives des concurrents auprès des jeunes professionnels de la profession comptable et proposer les réponses adaptées.

- Identifier les territoires, sections et formats les plus performants afin de concentrer les moyens sur les actions à plus fort potentiel.

Tu disposes d’environ 4 à 6 ans d’expérience dans les partenariats B2B, l’animation de réseau, le community growth, le développement commercial indirect ou le marketing terrain à forte dimension business.

Tu apprécies particulièrement le terrain, les déplacements réguliers en région et les échanges directs avec des communautés professionnelles. title: Responsable Déploiement / Implementation Manager
description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

🧩 Notre équipe Customer Operations

Chez Lifen, nous déployons nos solutions dans les hôpitaux de toute la France pour améliorer le quotidien des soignants et la qualité des soins.

L'équipe Customer Operations est le pont entre nos produits et les établissements de santé. Nous accompagnons chaque hôpital de A à Z dans l'implémentation de nos solutions : Lifen Documents & Lifen Intégration.

Notre équipe est composée de Project Managers et d'Operations Managers, tous pilotés par Loïc, notre Lead Customer Operations.

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

En tant qu'Operations Manager, tu seras au cœur du déploiement de nos solutions dans les établissements de santé :

Cadrage projet : organiser et animer les réunions de cadrage avec les établissements pour comprendre leurs besoins techniques et fonctionnels, et définir la meilleure intégration de nos solutions dans leur quotidien ; adapter ton discours selon tes interlocuteurs (responsables IT, chefs de projet, utilisateurs terrain).

Accompagnement fonctionnel : comprendre l'organisation des services hospitaliers et les parcours patients pour adapter nos solutions aux réalités terrain ; challenger les besoins clients et proposer les meilleures pratiques.

title: Field Marketing Specialist
description:
About Dust 

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. 

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. 

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 .

This Role

The French market is one of Dust’s most important growth levers, and the Marketing team plays a central role in supporting pipeline generation through events, content and account-based activations.

As field marketing specialist, France, you will be the execution owner for Dust’s local Marketing activities. Working closely with the France Marketing Lead, you will turn defined priorities into high-quality events, localized webinars, social media, content and partner marketing activations that support Sales, BDRs and pipeline generation.

The France Marketing Lead owns the strategy, budget, programme selection and priorities. You will own execution, coordination, content delivery and continuous improvement across the French Marketing motion.

You will be part of a growing Marketing team across the US, UK and France, managed by the Global Head of Marketing.

Key Responsibilities

Own the execution of the French event and webinar programme

- Execute conferences, Dust-owned events and localized webinars selected and scoped by the France Marketing Lead.

- Coordinate the preparation, stakeholders, content, landing pages and logistics needed for a smooth delivery.

- Work closely with Sales and BDRs to prepare target accounts, follow-up plans and event-related content.

- Collect feedback, measure performance and document learnings after each activity.

Own French social media and content activation

- Own social media execution for Dust around events, campaigns and key French-market topics.

- Support AEs with relevant content and messaging for their LinkedIn activity.

- Coordinate with Global Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Design and external media partners to deliver relevant content for French enterprise audiences.

- Turn events, customer conversations and market insights into reusable content, including customer stories, blog posts, videos, YouTube content and Sales assets.

Support partner marketing and Growth programmes

- Provide execution and logistical support for regional partner marketing activities within the strategy, selection and budget defined by the France Marketing Lead.

- Support Growth with French-market content for ABM, webinars and paid campaigns.

- Produce or reformat assets such as e-books, landing pages, customer content and campaign materials.

- Connect event, content and partner marketing activities to target account engagement and pipeline generation.

Coordinate cross-functional Marketing initiatives

- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive Marketing tasks , Build Dust agents and workflows to support research, event preparation, content repurposing, Sales enablement, reporting and follow-up.

Requirements

- 3+ years of experience in B2B Marketing , ideally across Field Marketing, Event Marketing, Content Marketing or Product Marketing, preferably in SaaS or technology.

- End-to-end event ownership with the ability to plan and deliver conferences, executive events and Dust-owned events, from preparation through execution and post-event follow-up.

- Strong content and social media skills with experience creating or repurposing content for enterprise audiences across social media, landing pages, customer stories, YouTube, Sales enablement and executive LinkedIn profiles.

- Commercial and pipeline mindset with a clear understanding of how events, content and account-based activities support Sales, BDRs, direct pipeline and partner-led growth.

- Excellent communication skills in French and English , both written and spoken. You can write clearly and accurately, adapt your tone to different audiences and communicate credibly with enterprise executives.

- Generalist and hands-on approach . You are comfortable moving between event ownership, content creation, Sales preparation, webinars, campaign assets and operational coordination.

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail . You anticipate needs, manage deadlines reliably and ensure that projects, events and content are properly prepared before launch.

- Self-starter mentality . You take initiative, make decisions, solve problems and own outcomes rather than waiting to be told what to do.

- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills . You know how to find and coordinate the right people across Marketing, Sales, BDRs, Customer Success, Partnerships and external partners.

- Nice to have: Experience marketing to French enterprise or CAC 40 audiences, working with agencies or media partners, supporting paid campaigns, producing webinars or video content, and working with tools such as HubSpot, Google Workspace and Figma.

- Location and travel: Based in Paris, comfortable working on-site and willing to travel occasionally for events in France.

What Makes This Role Unique

- Direct pipeline impact: Your work will directly support Sales and BDRs through events, content and ABM activations.

- Execution ownership in France: You will turn the priorities defined by the France Marketing Lead into high-quality events, content, social media and partner marketing activations in France.

- AI-native Marketing: You will use Dust to automate research, preparation, content production, reporting and follow-up.

- Generalist scope: The role combines events, content, social media, webinars, Sales enablement and ABM.

- Market-shaping opportunity: Help establish Dust as a leading voice in the French enterprise and agentic AI market.

Location 

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust 

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. 

Learn how we think and work. 

- Our product constitution, a story about our mission 

- Agents at work - Latent Space , podcast with our cofounder, Stanislas Polu, 2024

- LLMs reasoning and agentic capabilities over time - dotAI, podcast with our cofounder, Stanislas Polu, 2024

Compensation: €50K – €65K • Offers Equity

title: Group Cost Controller
description:
About Us 

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role 

As Group Cost Controller at Harmattan AI, you will take ownership of the Group’s Industrial, R&D & other operational costing, working closely with the FP&A Manager to structure, develop, and continuously improve Industrial P&L, Cost performance monitoring, and decision-support capabilities across multiple entities.

The role combines hands-on analytical execution with higher-level structuring responsibilities, including Industrial P&L creation & development, Industrial & R&D cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, and KPI definition.

Responsibilities 

- Build the industrial P&L and the costing framework. Create the industrial P&L, define the standard cost calculation methodology, and set up the performance tracking processes that go with it.

- Monitor and challenge production and inventory performance. Track production costs, inventory levels and variances, identify deviations early, and work with operations to close them.

- Run the industrial management cycles. Initiate and own monthly closings, business reviews, forecasts and budgets for the industrial scope.

- Contribute to the Odoo implementation. Work with Production and Supply Chain to ensure inventory is tracked reliably in the system and that the outputs the business needs come out of it.

- Drive cost visibility and optimization beyond the plant. Follow R&D and project costs, and lead cost optimization initiatives across other operating costs.

Candidate Requirements 

- Educational Background: Finance, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field (Master’s preferred)

- Industrial Controlling Expertise: 5–8 years in cost or industrial controlling within a manufacturing environment or a complex production environment 

- Modelling & Tools: Expert-level Excel and strong financial modelling skills, plus hands-on experience with an ERP . Comfortable with BOMs, standard costs and variance analysis.

- Builder's Mindset & Adaptability: Has built a controlling framework from a blank page rather than inherited one. Autonomous, structured, and at ease in a fast-moving environment where the answer does not exist yet.

- Business Partnering & Communication: A true business partner — curious about operations, comfortable on the shop floor, able to challenge production, engineering and procurement constructively. Fluent in French and English.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Data Engineer / Scientist – Multimodal Clinical Data Integration & AI (m/f/d)
description:
About aiPTO

aiPTO is a TechBio startup spun off from the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ), taking on one of medicine's hardest problems: brain cancer. We are building a disruptive approach — pairing next-generation patient-derived living tumor with fit-for-purpose virtual-tumor AI models. By recreating a patient's tumor biology in vitro and decoding it in silico, we aim to revolutionize brain cancer drug discovery and precision medicine. More details can be found on our publications (Individualized patient tumor organoids faithfully preserve human brain tumor ecosystems and predict patient response to therapy, DELPHAI predicts heterogeneous perturbation responses with learned single-cell fitness) and LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/aipto/).

The project

aiPTO has been selected as the data and AI partner of a newly funded Horizon Europe consortium that unites world-class neuro-oncologists, pathologists and drug-discovery pioneers across Europe. Together we are generating patient profiles of unprecedented depth: multi-omics, high-resolution digital pathology, 3D imaging and longitudinal clinical records, alongside single-cell drug-perturbation data from patient-derived organoids.

As the first member of our Heidelberg hub, you will build the data engine that turns these massive, disparate streams into AI-ready data atlas — the foundation for virtual tumor models and agentic systems designed to predict patient-specific drug response, decode resistance and reveal drug mechanisms.

What you will do

- Architect the scientific data engine: design, build and scale the infrastructure that unifies multi-omics, spatial transcriptomics, digital pathology, radiological imaging and clinical data

- Make data AI-ready: harmonise and standardise multimodal datasets for deep-learning models and agentic workflows, working hand-in-hand with our machine-learning and computer-vision scientists

- Bridge the disciplines: be the link between wet-lab researchers, clinical oncologists and IT scientists, translating biological questions into data schemas

- Own rigour and compliance: implement biomedical metadata standards and GDPR-grade governance for sensitive patient data

What you bring

- PhD, or MSc with 2+ years of experience, in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, biomedical engineering or a related quantitative field

- Demonstrated mastery in structuring and integrating complex biological or clinical datasets; hands-on experience with real-world patient data is a strong plus

- Depth in at least one modality — multi-omics, spatial biology, digital pathology or medical imaging — and familiarity with biomedical metadata standards

- Advanced Python and modern software-engineering practice; experience with database architecture, data tooling for biological workflows or AI coding assistants is highly valued

- A pioneering mindset: self-driven, curious and motivated by turning advanced technology into real patient impact in an agile startup

Why join aiPTO

- Direct patient impact: your work feeds models built for an aggressive cancer with few options — every well-structured dataset moves us closer to patient-matched therapy

- Founding leadership: as our first Heidelberg team member you shape the technology stack, the architecture and the hub

- World-class network: close collaboration with DKFZ, leading European clinical centres and international consortium partners

- Package and trajectory: competitive compensation, hybrid working, and a career path that accelerates as aiPTO scales

title: Engineering Manager Ads Backend
description:
YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND 

The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want. 

Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one. That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.

THE ROLE 

Video is the heart of all Zattoo’s services: thousands of 24/7 live TV channels plus on-demand content from dozens of providers. The Ads Backend team turns that content into a personalised, revenue-generating advertising experience.

As an Engineering Manager, you enable your team to do their best work: approachable, a good listener, and a strong facilitator of ideas and knowledge. You bring your own ideas for improving the architecture and extending what our systems can do.

This is a hands-on leadership role. We want a manager who is also a strong engineer, someone who acts as technical lead, dives into the code and architecture when it matters, and sets direction by example.

Ads Backend is your home base, not the limit of your influence. We expect you to collaborate deeply with the Ingest & Storage, Streaming & CDN, and Playback teams, help define the technical direction of video across Zattoo, and join cross-team initiatives. 

THE ADS BACKEND TEAM 

The team owns Zattoo’s in-house Server-Side Ad Insertion (SSAI) solution: the whole ad pipeline, from deciding which ads to show to tracking every impression, built as a suite of services serving viewers at scale. These are business-critical services with a direct revenue impact, and we collaborate closely with our sister teams (Ingest & Storage, Streaming & CDN, Playback) and commercial and ad operations stakeholders.

We’re about to take SSAI to the next level: a major re-architecture. It’s the team’s flagship challenge ahead, and one we want this hire to help lead from the front. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

- Lead the Ads Backend team, organizationally and technically

- Own the technical vision and architecture of our SSAI platform, with the senior developers

- Contribute hands-on as technical lead: review designs, raise the bar by example, and step into critical code when needed

- Own the end-to-end development process and operational excellence for revenue-impacting services

- Help shape the technical direction of Zattoo’s broader video platform, with the other video teams and our Principal Engineers

- Drive cross-team initiatives spanning across multiple video teams.

- Represent the team to stakeholders.

- Directly manage 2 – 4 engineers and lead hiring

- Grow, develop, and retain engineering talent

WHAT YOU’LL BRING 

- 5+ years leading engineering teams

- Strong, current hands-on engineering: you can design, build, and review production code and act as technical lead

- Proficient in C++/Go

- Experience building highly available services and APIs that scale

- Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures and message queues (e.g. Kafka), and non-relational databases (e.g. Scylla)

- Testing is a fundamental part of how you build software

- Fluent English, written and verbal

- Experience with advertising technology platforms, ad serving, and dynamic ad insertion (DAI/SSAI)

- Broad experience across the video pipeline (ingest, transcoding, packaging, DRM, streaming, playback)

WHY JOIN US? 

At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU 

- Reward : strong market competitive salary

- Recharge : 30 days vacation plus public holidays

- Regulate : trust based flexible working hours and the option for remote work worldwide for up to 8 weeks per year 

Plus: 

- We’re sharing: Free access to the best streaming experience on the market

- We're developing: Your own development budget, German classes and Zattoo all-company hack days

- We’re inclusive: ‘ Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities

- We’re healthy: Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more!

- We’re responsible: We are carbon neutral, an active employee Green team, discounted BVG tickets and free bike rentals

- We’re sociable: A calendar of events with fireside chats, lunches, in-house bar, BBQ’s, monthly socials, summer party and an annual off-site event

Zattoo enables our users to view indiscriminately and we reflect that in our team too. Regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law we encourage everyone to apply and will give everyone equal consideration. We are an equal opportunities employer — join us and help build a diverse team dedicated to revolutionising the way you watch TV.

We are committed to ensuring fair, open, and equitable hiring practices and are happy to answer any questions you may have about us or the role throughout the whole process. In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we share the applicable compensation range with you before your first interview.

You can learn more about us at: https://zattoo.com

description:

At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful.

Through our platforms GotPhoto.com and fotograf.de , we help professional photographers simplify and transform the way they work — from photo management and client communication to ordering and payment processing. Our end-to-end workflow and e-commerce solution gives photographers more time to focus on what matters most: being behind the lens.

Since 2012, we’ve built a sustainable and profitable business driven by entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a deep understanding of photographers’ everyday challenges. Today, thousands of photographers trust our software , creating their own success stories along the way.

As the leading e-commerce engine for professional volume photographers and a business backed by EQT, one of the world’s leading private equity firms, we’re powered by a team of 150+ talented and international people building technology that simplifies photographers’ everyday work and helps them focus on capturing meaningful moments.

Join us on our journey to empower photographers like never before.

At GotPhoto, we are transforming a highly manual industry—Volume Photography—into a seamless digital experience. As our Office & Team Assistant , you act as an operational self-starter who loves variety: from ensuring our physical space looks pristine and managing our product returns process, to keeping our CEO-office's calendar and team perfectly organized. If you are proactive, deeply structured, and love a hands-on environment where your work has a daily visible impact, let’s talk!

- Champion our Office Environment: Take absolute ownership of the morning look and feel of our Berlin workspace; manage physical tidiness, keep standard office areas organized.

- Empower our CEO-office: Act as the strategic time manager for our CEO-office; proactively handle calendar scheduling, coordinate travel itineraries, and shield them from scheduling conflicts or double-bookings.

- Build a Vibrant Workplace Culture: Partner closely with the People Team to create an organized, positive atmosphere where employees and visitors love to spend their time.

What You Bring 

Experience

- The Operational Core: You have a background in Office Management, Team Assistance, or a deeply customer-centric environment such as a premium hotel reception or hospitality desk.

- Fast-Paced Fluency: You have previously worked in environments that required handling physical tasks alongside digital coordination seamlessly.

- SaaS or Tech Exposure: Experience working in a dynamic, international startup or scale-up ecosystem is a plus.

Skills

- Tool Proficiency: You are fully literate in Google Workspace (especially Google Calendar) and comfortable managing spreadsheets in Microsoft Excel.

- Flawless Communication: You possess strong, clear verbal and written communication skills in English and German.

- Organizational Brilliance: You know how to prioritize incoming tasks dynamically, keeping logistical data organized while simultaneously managing executive travel requests.

Mindset

- Hands-on & Proactive: You don't wait for a manual; you see what needs to be fixed, tidied, or adjusted and you take immediate care of it.

- Deeply Autonomous: You enjoy having ownership over your domain, working independently to hit daily operational goals.

- High Trust & Discretion: You possess the professional maturity and discretion required when handling executive logistics and collaborating directly with C-level leadership.

Why You’ll Love Life at GotPhoto 

- Recharge & Unwind: We value your downtime. You start with 26 days of leave, plus we love to top that up with additional discretionary "X-days" to make sure you’re truly rested.

title: Senior Robotics Engineer (m/f/d) – Drone Port
description:
At Quantum Systems, we are building the next generation of autonomous aerial systems. The Drone Port is a key element of this vision, enabling fully autonomous launch, landing, charging, health monitoring and mission readiness of our UAV platforms.

As a Senior Robotics Engineer , you will play a central role in developing the intelligence that allows the Drone Port and aircraft to interact seamlessly. You will work on perception algorithms, control systems, embedded software and sensor integration to create reliable autonomous behaviours that operate in real-world environments.

Working closely with experts from Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Systems Engineering Flight Controls, Embedded Software, AI and Flight Test, you will help shape one of the most advanced autonomous drone infrastructure products on the market. Your work will directly influence the future of fully autonomous BVLOS operations and scalable drone deployments worldwide.

What is your Day to Day Mission: 

- Design and implement robotic capabilities enabling fully autonomous Drone Port operation.

- Develop perception algorithms for precision landing, docking, localisation and environmental awareness.

- Design and optimize closed-loop control algorithms for ground-based robotic systems and UAV interactions.

- Develop embedded software for sensors, actuators and hardware interfaces. 

- Integrate cameras, ranging sensors, IMUs, encoders and additional perception sensors into the overall system architecture.

- Develop robust sensor fusion algorithms for reliable operation under varying environmental conditions.

- Design and validate communication interfaces between the Drone Port, aircraft and cloud infrastructure.

- Develop software for autonomous system monitoring, diagnostics and fault detection.

- Support hardware bring-up, integration and system validation in laboratory and field environments.

- Analyse test results, debug complex system behaviour and continuously improve system robustness.

- Collaborate closely with Mechanical, Electrical and Systems Engineering throughout the complete product development lifecycle.

- Support flight and field testing of autonomous Drone Port capabilities.

- Contribute to software architecture, coding standards and engineering best practices.

- Mentor junior engineers and actively contribute to the technical growth of the robotics team.

What you bring to the team: 

- Master's degree or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related discipline.

- Several years of professional experience developing robotic or autonomous systems.

- Strong programming skills in modern C++ and Python.

- Experience developing embedded software in C/C++.

- Strong understanding of robotics fundamentals including:

- Perception

- State estimation

- Sensor fusion

- Motion planning

- Feedback control

- Experience with robotic middleware such as ROS or ROS2.

- Experience integrating cameras, IMUs, LiDAR, UWB, radar or similar sensors.

- Familiarity with computer vision libraries such as OpenCV.

- Experience implementing real-time control systems.

- Experience with machine learning for robotic perception.

- Experience with Linux-based embedded systems.

- Familiarity with Git and modern CI/CD development workflows.

- Strong systems thinking and the ability to work across software, electronics and mechanics.

- Experience with autonomous vehicles, UAVs, industrial robotics, mobile robots or automated machinery is highly desirable.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Fluent English

Why Quantum-Systems: 

- We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

- We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. 

- We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

- We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.

Our benefits: 

- Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

- Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

- Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working.

- Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

- Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

- Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

- Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

- Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Pasing in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.

About us: 

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.

Our commitment:

You’ll turn ideas from research papers into rigorous experiments, measurable evidence, and reliable products.
The role spans model evaluation, model internals, inference infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing product experiences.
You’ll work hands-on with modern ML models, designing evaluations that reveal what methods can—and cannot—demonstrate.
You’ll also build production-grade tooling that makes complex experiments repeatable, observable, and accessible to users.

It’s an opportunity to help transform emerging ML techniques into practical systems that people can trust.

- Reproduce and evaluate machine learning research methods using open-weight and API-accessible models.

- Design evaluation datasets, probes, scoring approaches, baselines, calibration tests, and experiment harnesses.

- Work directly with model weights, logits, hidden states, activations, model APIs, and inference infrastructure when required.

- Build and extend evaluation infrastructure covering experiment runners, judges, persistence, orchestration, reporting, and reproducibility.

- Turn research workflows into intuitive product experiences, including experiment configuration, execution, traces, comparisons, reports, and review workflows.

- Investigate how verification methods behave when models are modified through fine-tuning, merging, quantization, distillation, safety removal, or deliberate evasion.

- Contribute across research, experimentation, engineering, and product as priorities evolve.

- During the first six months, reproduce and document at least one published model-provenance or verification method, including its capabilities, assumptions, and limitations.

- Build a repeatable model-verification runner with versioned inputs, artifacts, metrics, and reports, and make at least one verification workflow accessible through the product interface.

- Run controlled experiments across base, fine-tuned, merged, quantized, and known distilled models, improving understanding of when verification methods succeed, fail, and why.

Requirements:

- Strong Python engineering skills, with hands-on experience using PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.

- Solid understanding of machine learning evaluation, including dataset design, baselines, metrics, calibration, false positives and negatives, statistical uncertainty, and reproducibility.

- Ability to read ML research papers critically and implement methods from first principles rather than relying entirely on existing packages.

- Professional software engineering experience beyond notebooks, including APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, logging, testing, deployment, and documentation.

- Familiarity with open-weight models and a practical understanding of how modern LLM inference systems operate.

- Ability to work across backend and frontend boundaries, with sufficient React/TypeScript knowledge to help make complex experiments and results understandable to users.

- Strong experimental and analytical judgment, particularly around distinguishing what evidence demonstrates from what it merely suggests.

- High ownership and initiative, with the ability to identify problems, propose solutions, and drive projects forward independently.

- Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities can change quickly and engineers may operate across multiple functions.

- Experience with model provenance, fingerprinting, watermarking, distillation detection, red-teaming, safety evaluation, interpretability, or related areas is a plus.

- Experience with activation and representation analysis, probing, model hooks, logits, hidden states, or other model-internals techniques is advantageous.

- Familiarity with evaluation and inference infrastructure such as DSPy, LiteLLM, Temporal, Ray, vLLM, PostgreSQL/pgvector, or comparable technologies is beneficial.

- Experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, data visualization, or experiment dashboards is a plus.

- Experience running and serving open-weight models on GPUs, including reasoning about latency, throughput, memory, precision, and cost trade-offs, is valuable.

- Experience designing adversarial evaluations or testing systems against deliberate attempts to evade detection is an advantage.

- A strong commitment to producing production-quality code, tests, tooling, and documentation that other engineers can confidently operate and extend.

- A role with significant technical autonomy and the opportunity to shape both experiments and production systems.

- The opportunity to build systems and evaluation methodologies designed to produce evidence that users can understand and trust.

We are traide AI – a VC-backed, B2B deep tech startup based in Berlin, using AI to solve one of the most overlooked yet critical challenges in international trade: customs compliance. Our software automates product classification, reduces regulatory errors, and helps customers save up to 83% of their time.

Your main expertise lies in backend technology but you should not be afraid to contribute to other parts of the application.

- Own the end-to-end delivery of new features and improvements in our web application across the whole stack: shaping everything from technical design to production release
- Write both client-side and server-side code within our well-established codebases
- Analyse and communicate trade-offs in technical designs in RFC style discussions, drive decisions for your projects
- Be the backend expert in rotating project teams, give feedback on the contribution of other team members within your area of expertise
Cross-functional collaboration 

- Work alongside designers to shape user flows, evaluate feasibility, and improve interfaces and user experience

- Contribute your perspective to product discussions, helping set direction with both technical and user impact in mind
Code quality & technical excellence - Set and uphold high standards for code quality, architecture, and best practices within the team

- Design and maintain robust automated tests to ensure reliability and quality at scale

- Develop and improve instructions, guardrails and feedback mechanisms for coding agents

- Select and configure tooling that improves developer experience and keeps our CI/CD pipeline efficient

- Proactively identify and solve technical challenges before they become blockers

Knowledge sharing 

- Share your expertise through code reviews, mentoring, and documentation — helping others level up and ensuring our knowledge grows as the team grows

Who we’re looking for You're an experienced engineer who cares deeply about craft, but even more about impact. You love clear thinking over hype, and you're energized by the idea of turning AI research into products people actually use every day.

- 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience , ideally building complex products in dynamic environments
- Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science or a related discipline
- Deep proficiency in TypeScript , including advanced type-level programming
- Familiarity with synchronous and asynchronous communication patterns , HTTP APIs ( REST and GraphQL ), event-driven architecture, and common design patterns.
- Solid database skills across both relational and non-relational databases such as Postgres and Redis or similar.
- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud , and the services that typically come with them.
- You embrace AI tools in your workflow and are driven to master emerging technologies
- You champion code quality and drive best practices across the team
- You thrive in fast-moving environments - seeking opportunities to learn, grow, and both give and receive feedback
- Strong English skills (C1 or better); German is a plus but not required
- Curiosity about adjacent fields like DevOps, Security, Frontend development, AI Engineering etc.
Our Tech Stack: - React & Chakra UI (Component library)
- GraphQL
- Node.js & Prisma (ORM)
- Python & FastAPI & SQLAlchemy
- Postgres for storage & Redis for caching & messages
- Terraform / Open Tofu orchestrating Google Cloud Platform

Why us? - Varied day-to-day : Every feature comes with unique technical challenges → no two days are the same
- Visible impact : You'll see the direct results of your work → for both our customers and traide AI
- Direct impact on product : Your technical decisions shape what we ship and how it performs

title: Sales Development Representative (German Speaking)
description:
At Sanity.io , we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. What you will do

You're not waiting for leads to land in your lap. You'll be out there, on the phone, in inboxes, sliding into LinkedIn DMs (professionally), starting real conversations with people who have real problems Sanity can solve. You find them, you qualify them, you build the pipeline.
